disposition_reason: The abstract and results text print overall and selected regional means of Cr, Pb, As and Cd in 130 dried chili samples from nine Guizhou regions.

study.design: Regional survey of dried chili from production bases with health risk assessment
study.origin: major chili production bases in nine regions of Guizhou Province, China
study.method: Microwave digestion with HNO3 (0.5 g, 200 C, 30 min); ICP-MS (Thermo iCAP-Q)
lod: not reported in the main text
study.qa: reagent blanks; duplicate samples (relative deviation <5%); spike recoveries 90.8-115%

findings.group: all nine regions of Guizhou Province
findings.notes: Collected at major production bases in 2023, oven-dried at 70 C for 72 h and ground; ICP-MS. Basis dry (lab-dried). Region n is 10-20 samples; exact per-region n is in Supplementary Table 10, not available.

unresolved: Per-region means for all metals are in Supplementary Tables 3-10, which were not found next to the PDF; only regions printed in the text were extracted. Fig. 2 regional values not read.
A value "QDN (0.578 ± 0.189 mg/kg) ... for Cd" appears to be arsenic; flagged and recorded as tAs.
EDI values in the text are labelled µg/day but appear to be per kg body weight; not used.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: China GB 2762-2022 limits for dried chili peppers
THQ and TTHQ below 1 in all regions; TCR below 1e-4
